acceptance: A test loads the checked-in .evolve/policy.json and fails when subprocessCap plus the largest ACS lane sum exceeds acs.go_timeout_s.
The bound message names the caller deadline when that is the earlier bound (subprocess_bound.go:53).
fix: Give the relation subprocessCap + largest lane sum <= acs.go_timeout_s an executable home: a test over the real policy file. Name the caller deadline in the bound message.
summary: The ACS subprocess bound (subprocessCap 300 s in go/pkg/acsassert/subprocess_bound.go:16) only works while 300 s plus the largest lane sum (187 s) stays under acs.go_timeout_s (600 s in .evolve/policy.json). The relation is stated in the plan and pkg-acsassert.md but no test relates the Go constant to the policy value, so lowering go_timeout_s below about 487 s silently brings back the one-hang-spends-the-lane defect.
title: A test pins that the ACS subprocess cap fits inside the ACS Go timeout
